entities.name: Go-Shintai of Shared Purpose
entities.description: Legendary shrine housing a Kami of Shared Purpose, built by rural Kamigawa farmers.

entities.name: Kami of Shared Purpose
entities.description: Kami that taught farmers to work together and took residence in their shrine.

events.summary: Farmers threatened by a flooding river built a shrine and attracted a Kami of Shared Purpose.
events.quote: they built a small shrine as an offering and attracted a Kami of Shared Purpose

events.summary: The kami taught them to dig trenches, saved the fields, and took permanent residence in the shrine.
events.quote: the kami chose to take permanent residence in the shrine
